name: Slayed Beauty
description: Slayed Beauty is a glam hair and beauty studio for updos and special-occasion styling, color, extensions, silk presses, lashes, and makeup — every client leaves slayed, crowned, and camera-ready.

hero.title: Get slayed. Wear the crown.
hero.subtitle: Glam updos, color, extensions, silk presses, lashes, and makeup for every occasion — book your slay today.

stylists.title: Founder & Beauty Artist
stylists.bio: The founder of Slayed Beauty is all about making every client feel like royalty. From glam updos and special-occasion styling to color, extensions, and full glam makeup, she makes sure you leave slayed and camera-ready.

reviews.name: Bianca R.
reviews.text: She did my hair and makeup for my birthday and I was SLAYED. Felt like a queen all night!

reviews.name: Gabriela M.
reviews.text: My updo was gorgeous and held up through hours of dancing. So talented!

reviews.name: Tiara J.
reviews.text: Best color I've had in a long time. The studio vibes are amazing too.

reviews.name: Vanessa P.
reviews.text: Bridal hair and makeup were flawless. Thank you for making my day perfect!
